page.overview:
Who is Akane's Father?

He is the father of Akane and a bridge builder. He was also a friend of Kaiza.

Akane's father really cares about his son and was worried when Akane went missing.

Akane's father has black hair with a patch of it going down onto the middle part of his forehead. He also wears a brown straw hat. He also wore a blueish greenish T-shirt.

When Akane hadn't returned home from playing with his friends, he and the other villagers go to Tazuna's house to inquire about it, knowing the children were last seen with Inari.
